reviews.author: Wamika Borde
reviews.body: Mujhe iska clean finish aur elegant shine bahut pasand aayi. Ye pendant expensive jewellery jaisa feel deta hai bina extra flashy hue. ❤️

reviews.author: Charul Singhal
reviews.body: Maine kaafi pendants compare kiye the, lekin iska design sabse unique laga. Real product dekhne ke baad laga ki choice bilkul sahi thi. 😊

reviews.author: Ujjwal Nanda
reviews.body: Package receive karte hi quality ka idea ho gaya tha. Box se lekar pendant tak sab kuch well presented tha aur premium experience mila.

reviews.author: Ojasvi Sengar
reviews.body: Friends ne pehli baar dekhte hi compliment diya ki pendant ka design bahut different aur elegant lag raha hai.
